newsitem.title: USA: Diamond receives S&P listing approval.
newsitem.headline: Diamond receives S&P listing approval.

text.p: Diamond Laser International Limited said on Friday the company's application for listing in the Standard & Poor's Corp's Standard Corporation records was accepted on December 20 1996 for eventual coverage within the publication.
Standard & Poor's will publish the initial corporate description of the company within the "Daily News" section of corporation records within 10 business days on or about January 8 1997.
The description will then appear in the next available update to the C-E volume, scheduled for April 1997.
